feeds.title: Human Rights Centre Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1982, the University of Essex Human Rights Centre is one of the world's leading centres for the interdisciplinary study of the theory and practice of human rights. Their members are actively engaged in the practice of human rights. Their research is based upon the strategic identification of enduring and emerging human rights challenges.

feeds.title: Voice of Salam
feeds.description: Welcome to Voice of Salam! It is all about exposing injustice, breaking down barriers and building mutual understanding. Through writing and video, we're leading campaigns, raising awareness and creating change.

feeds.title: UK Human Rights Blog
feeds.description: The UK Human Rights Blog aims to provide a free, comprehensive, and balanced legal update service. This blog is run by 1 Crown Office Row barristers' chambers. We post on a huge range of legal issues, from human rights to public, medical, and environmental law.

feeds.title: Lacuna Magazine
feeds.description: Our blog tells untold stories, championing new voices, and featuring stories from the frontline of humanitarianism, justice, and politics. Lacuna is an online human rights magazine that fills the gap between the short-term immediacy of daily journalism and long-term academic analysis.

feeds.title: OHRH Blog
feeds.description: Explore current events from a global human rights perspective, with in-depth op-eds, interviews and more. The Oxford Human Rights Hub aims to bring together academics, practitioners, and policy-makers from across the globe to advance the understanding and protection of human rights and equality.

feeds.title: Liberty Blog
feeds.description: Liberty challenges injustice defends freedom and campaigns to make sure everyone in the UK is treated fairly. Making the UK a fairer, more equal place since 1934. Read thoughts and opinions on Human Rights and Government Accountability among other issues in our blog.

feeds.title: EachOther News
feeds.description: We are EachOther producing up to date human rights news and video, and putting more focus on human stories particularly involving marginalised groups who don't get enough mainstream coverage, exclusive research, short documentaries, powerful illustrations, as well as comment and analysis from experts and those directly affected by an issue.

feeds.title: Equally Ours » Gender
feeds.description: Equally Ours is a UK charity that brings together people and organizations working across equality, human rights, and social justice. We believe that a good and strong society is a just and inclusive one. One where we are free from harm and can all contribute and flourish, whoever we are, whatever we believe in, and whatever we do and don't have. A society that is equally ours.

feeds.title: Human Rights Consortium
feeds.description: The Human Rights Consortium hosted by the School of Advanced Study has been established to facilitate and promote research in human rights in the UK and internationally. It is closely associated with the Institute of Commonwealth Studies, with which it delivers the UK's longest-running interdisciplinary practice-based MA in Understanding and Securing Human Rights.

feeds.title: Lawyers for Palestinian Human Rights Blog
feeds.description: Lawyers for Palestinian Human Rights is a legal charity in the UK that works on projects focused on protecting and promoting Palestinian human rights. Their primary strategic aim is to effect a positive transformation of the urgent and critical human rights situation for Palestinians.

feeds.title: University of Leeds Human Rights Journal Blog
feeds.description: Our Human Rights Journal Blog is dedicated to shorter written and creative pieces related to human rights. Read gritty, incisive pieces on Human Rights issues across the globe submitted by staff and guest writers. The University of Leeds Human Rights Journal provides a platform for passionate undergraduates to publish their academic and creative work on the theme of human rights.

feeds.title: Equality and Human Rights Commission Blog
feeds.description: Read from our staff and guest bloggers on equality and human rights issues, the latest news and updates on the work we do to uphold equality and human rights ideals and laws. The Equality and Human Rights Commission is a parliament-mandated commission promoting and upholding equality and human rights ideals and laws across the UK.
